summary: Iter 54b full backend + frontend regression. Backend pytest 17/17 PASS (0 skipped). Frontend Playwright: /warsztaty list + workshop-search-{q,city,type,submit} + workshop cards render; /warsztaty/{slug} shows workshop-header + workshop-description + workshop-specializations + workshop-history + workshop-back (verified showing our TEST service entry pushed via /api/business/service-entry — end-to-end owner→workshop approval flow proven). Admin panel (/gv91-admin) sidebar has 'Firmy' + 'Waitlist Premium'; Firmy table has filter buttons (Wszystkie/Oczekujące/Aktywne/Pro), Aktywuj + Zweryfikuj (or Cofnij weryfikację) actions; Waitlist has admin-waitlist-export CSV button (5 rows visible). /marketplace/new type=parts renders all 8 requested testids (listing-part-cond-new/used/refurbished, listing-part-make, listing-part-model, listing-part-oem, listing-part-price-type, listing-part-shipping). type=service renders all 8 service categories (listing-service-cat-{mechanic,body,detailing,tires,electric,tuning,towing,other}). /business/dashboard for user without business_account correctly renders empty-account state with 'Załóż konto firmowe' CTA→/register/business. QR-scan flow verified end-to-end at API level: workshop user scanning owner's vehicle short-URL triggered activated_and_requested + workshop_vehicle_access record; 403 for non-owner responding; owner-approve unlocks POST /business/service-entry.

minor.issue: Slug 'vehicle-hub-301' referenced in the review request does NOT exist in the DB (only 4 activated businesses present: test-ws-*, test-admin-*, test-qa-*). Tests were adapted to pick the first activated slug dynamically. If E1 intended to seed a fixture workshop with this slug, that seed is missing. Projection logic itself works correctly (verified against real activated slugs — email/nip/owner_user_id all hidden, is_owner=false).

issues: Under rapid page loads a Brevo/limiter 429 flood was observed on unrelated polling endpoints; not tied to Iter 54b logic, cleared after 3-second cooldown. Cosmetic — page still renders empty state correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL: seed a demo business_account with slug='vehicle-hub-301' if the review request literally expects that URL to resolve (currently 404). All logic works — this is only a seed-data gap.
critical_code_review_comments: public_share.get_public_vehicle_short catches ALL exceptions in the B2B side-effect block silently (workshop_action=None). Good for isolating the public path from B2B failures, but consider logging the exception so QR-scan errors don't disappear silently in prod.

business.request_vehicle_access sends owner notification email via fire_and_forget — good. But the last_scanned_at update on existing rows does NOT re-notify — correct anti-spam behavior; worth a code comment.

marketplace._notify_part_alerts is fired via asyncio.create_task inside the listing-create request; ensure the FastAPI event-loop task reference is retained somewhere or use a bounded background pool for production scale (currently fire-and-forget can be GC'd on very high concurrency).
business.py file grew to 460 lines mixing register + list + history + access + service-entry — consider splitting into business_public.py + business_access.py near 700-line threshold.

BusinessDashboard.js: toast.error('Brak konta firmowego') fires on every visit for users without a business_account. Consider silencing this specific 403 since the empty-state UI already communicates it.
